Dear Rahul,

I am writing to express my interest in the Software Developer Internship position you mentioned. After reviewing VIT’s profile, I was particularly impressed by the projects and initiatives your organization is involved in, which align well with my academic interests and professional aspirations.

Enclosed, please find my updated resume for your consideration. I have also attached a brief overview of some of my recent projects that might be relevant to this role. I am keen on contributing to VIT's goals and gaining practical experience in software development during the summer internship program.

I look forward to the possibility of discussing how my skills can complement VIT’s objectives and contribute positively to the team. If there is any additional information or documentation that you require, please let me know.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Best regards,
Lakshya
